name: conswap
description: Context switching for work spread over Slack, GitHub, Claude and my own head.

scripts.dev: npm run build:server && npm -w @conswap/desktop run dev
scripts.dev:no-sandbox: npm run build:server && npm -w @conswap/desktop run dev:no-sandbox

scripts.type-check: npm -w @conswap/backend run type-check && npm -w @conswap/desktop run type-check
